_meta.description: Printer intelligence database: firmware quirks, material compatibility, calibration guidance, and known failure modes. Keyed by the same printer_id as safety_profiles.json.
_meta._split_note: Safety-floor profile for AI-controlled FDM printing.  Engineering depth (quirks + calibration recipes + failure_modes + per-material notes) is available in Kiln Pro; see https://kiln3d.com/pricing.

extended_hardware_schema.scope: marketed printer models; default and klipper_generic are non-model fallbacks
extended_hardware_schema.null_semantics: manufacturer does not publish a fixed value, or hardware is builder-selected
extended_hardware_schema.ams_slots_semantics: inputs or tools on one supported first-party automated-material or tool-changing system; 0 means the manufacturer confirms no such system
extended_hardware_schema.max_speed_semantics: manufacturer-published maximum print, motion, or travel ceiling; not a recommended quality speed
